question_text: Explain one benefit and one limitation of processing a shared application’s database requests on a central server rather than independently on every client.
adaptation_rationale: Retains client-server resource trade offs without server-scripting taxonomy.
solution: Server centralizes the authoritative resource/processing rules.; Clients can use the service without each hosting the entire database or its credentials.; The system depends on server/network availability; server-side placement alone does not guarantee speed or security.
